description: This file is a Rust source code example demonstrating QR code generation, including various demos and utilities for creating and printing QR codes with different features and configurations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main application program that runs various QR code demos.

methods.name: do_basic_demo
methods.description: Creates and prints a basic QR code with 'Hello, world!' text.

methods.name: do_variety_demo
methods.description: Generates and prints multiple QR codes with different data and error correction levels.

methods.name: do_segment_demo
methods.description: Creates QR codes with manually specified segments for better data encoding.

methods.name: do_mask_demo
methods.description: Generates QR codes with different mask patterns to compare visual differences.

methods.name: print_qr
methods.description: Prints a QR code to the console using ASCII characters.

methods.name: to_chars
methods.description: Converts a string slice to a vector of characters.
